held.dish: Shiga-chicken shoyu and shio ramen, plus maguro (tuna)-broth bowls
held.w: Ramen shop opened 2014 by Yasuyuki Hiramatsu, trained in the Mentetsu group; shoyu/shio on Shiga chicken and tuna-based soups. A Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2025 pick and on Ramen Beast's curated list.

held.dish: two-kinds-of-tuna bowl (toro & akami) and tuna rolls
held.n: Maguroya Kurogin Kuromon (まぐろや黒銀 黒門)
held.w: Kuromon Market outpost of the Tsukiji tuna wholesaler; Time Out singles out its tuna bowls and rolls as the exception in a pricey market, and SAVOR JAPAN's Kuromon editorial recommends the two-tuna bowl.
